- name: Set up the exact controller Python
        id: controller_python312
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5

python-version: '3.12.10'
          architecture: 'x64'
      - name: Set up the exact native-parser compatibility Python
        id: native_ast_python311
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11.9'
          architecture: 'x64'
          update-environment: false

- name: Verify all frozen native fragment identities in both exact interpreters
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
          $native=Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $env:ONEHAND_SOURCE_PACKAGE) 'native-producer-reviewed'
          $python311='${{ steps.native_ast_python311.outputs.python-path }}'
          $python312='${{ steps.controller_python312.outputs.python-path }}'
          & $python311 -I -B -c 'import sys;assert sys.version_info[:3]==(3,11,9)'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Exact native-parser Python3.11.9 required' }
          & $python312 -I -B -c 'import sys;assert sys.version_info[:3]==(3,12,10)'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Exact controller Python3.12.10 required' }
          python -I -B -c 'import os,sys;assert sys.version_info[:3]==(3,12,10);assert os.path.samefile(sys.executable,sys.argv[1])' $python312
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Controller interpreter changed during compatibility setup' }
          & $python311 -I -B (Join-Path $native 'run_fragment_compatibility.py') --report (Join-Path $env:ONEHAND_WORK 'source-evidence/native-fragments-python311.json')
          $native311Exit=$LASTEXITCODE
          & $python312 -I -B (Join-Path $native 'run_fragment_compatibility.py') --report (Join-Path $env:ONEHAND_WORK 'source-evidence/native-fragments-python312.json')
          $native312Exit=$LASTEXITCODE
          if ($native311Exit -ne 0 -or $native312Exit -ne 0) { throw 'Exact cross-interpreter native fragment checks failed before vendor installation' }

${{ runner.temp }}/onehand-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/source-evidence/native-fragments-python311.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/onehand-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/source-evidence/native-fragments-python312.json
